carbon.title: Gemini 4 Carbon Model Card
carbon.significance: Carbon is the parent model from which Neon was adapted. Its card documents the starting architecture, data and infrastructure.
carbon.connection: DeepMind directs readers to the Gemini 4 Carbon model card for details of the underlying architecture. Neon's own evaluation describes how the adapted model performed.
